body_html:
#smallpoems
#clmooc

Time melts
In relative
  keys
of mighty archipelagos
limbering bright,
and white
Arpeggios of
grandeur
lost in vast seas
  of squander
half steps of humanity
crumbling in whole steps of
time as accidental
modulations fall
Crescendo of cascading
ablating streams singing
 while
    Our Varianttonart
sails on, ice
melting in a symphony
of a shared denouement.
